summary: Ansible always creates all (every host) and ungrouped (hosts in no other group), so each host is in at least two groups; these may be implicit and missing from group_names.
questions: What are the all and ungrouped groups?
Which groups does a host belong to by default?

answer_card.title: Default all and ungrouped groups
answer_card.answer_md:
- `all` contains every host.
- `ungrouped` contains hosts not in any other group.

Every host is in at least two groups: `all` plus either `ungrouped` or its own group. These can be implicit and may not show up in listings like `group_names`.
